description:
A delicious GUI for Chocolatey

Chocolatey GUI is a delicious GUI on top of the Chocolatey command line tool.
Bug Fixes
- Splash screen is always visible regardless of attempts to interact with other applications.
  - See #890 by JohnVeness, resolved in !1029 by garas.
- When requesting "All versions" for a package the same version number is incorrectly repeated.
  - See #1146 by HypnoticYeti, resolved in !1148 by gep13.
Documentation
- Clarify Chocolatey GUI WCAG status, suggesting users make use of Chocolatey CLI.
  - See !1054 by pauby raised in #645 by mkevenaar.
Enhancement
- Use the word "Upgrade" instead of "Update" for consistency.
  - See #937 by Windos, resolved in !1145 by AdmiringWorm.
Contributors
8 contributors made this release possible.
